method: Static file inspection only, not product execution. Literal runtime imports, reexports, dynamic imports and URL resources are followed; type-only imports are excluded. An intersecting changed module is a conservative material witness until a separately recorded symbol-level review excludes the called path. Workspace package/dependency configuration is checked against the complete remote diff.

configuration.dependencyAndWorkspacePackages: The complete W20→W1 and W1→W2 comparisons contain no Bun lock, package manifest, @orchestra/core, rag-engine, external-module implementation, or Bun setup-action changes. Source-only reuse does not generalize beyond the scoped original test observations.

scopeExclusionDefinitions.business-context-reissue-only-planner-re: Only wp08/reissue.test.ts is excluded: its host resolver issues Planner refs and returns fresh/unavailable; the changed Procurement historical-source branch cannot execute. createSfBusinessContext body and canonical helpers are unchanged; unused Atlas/router factories are not called.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.state-provider-no-procurement-evidence-p: The added branch hashes only preferences with sf:procurement-evidence: prefix and denies a changed prefix without the root capability. Reviewed reusable candidate/schema/import-stage/thread/reissue/analysis-acceptance paths never write these preferences. No global exclusion applies to the Atlas consumer or selected affected tests.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.fixture-optional-procurement-evidence-ca: For older callers that omit the new optional value, the new argument passes undefined; remaining fixture dependencies are still followed.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.fixture-prepared-target-hook-absent-and-: The fixture supplies no authorizePreparedTarget callback and does not mutate Procurement evidence preferences; the new optional branch returns undefined exactly as before. Other dependencies are still followed.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.download-xlsx-early-return-unchanged-bef: export-download-privacy.test.ts calls download("xlsx") only. The unchanged early branch imports unchanged workbooks.ts and returns exportPlanner before all modified Procurement CSV/PO code.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.application-htmlPolicy-export-identical-: htmlPolicy text is identical. This excludes only a named import of htmlPolicy, never createApplication or emitted browser SCRIPT.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.wp06-document-import-operation-schema-re: Data-only generated-schema parsing proves complete reachable $ref graph equivalence for sf_document_extract, sf_import_preview, sf_knowledge_search and sf_evidence_get despite definition renumbering. CommercialComparison, ContributionEnvelope, sf_sourcing_compare and PurchasePreparationInput are explicitly changed and never generally excluded.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.unchanged-admin-roleMap-calls-only-empty: roleMap alone calls unchanged emptyMap/rows/text. It does not call configure or conflict. Only this named-import call path is pruned.
scopeExclusionDefinitions.source-inventory-reads-only-unchanged-li: enumerateSfSources consumes Dashboard*.pages arrays only; all four literal page lists are byte-identical, and neither domain.execute nor rendering is called on this edge.
